scenarios.title: Spell ZS-ABC
scenarios.context: Written token only; no station or clearance is involved.
scenarios.prompt: Spell the training token ZS-ABC using the phonetic alphabet.
scenarios.model: Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Keep the letter order. This is a spelling exercise, not a real aircraft identification claim.

scenarios.title: Spell JQX
scenarios.context: Practise unfamiliar letter combinations.
scenarios.prompt: Spell JQX.
scenarios.model: Juliett Quebec X-ray.
scenarios.notes: The checker accepts ordinary written spelling variants but does not evaluate pronunciation.

scenarios.title: Spell ZS-KLM
scenarios.context: Written token only.
scenarios.prompt: Spell ZS-KLM.
scenarios.model: Zulu Sierra Kilo Lima Mike.
scenarios.notes: Listen back and ask a partner to reconstruct all five letters.

scenarios.title: Pressure-setting digits
scenarios.context: Synthetic pressure-setting exercise, not current weather information.
scenarios.prompt: Read QNH 1018 as a labelled pressure-setting value.
scenarios.model: QNH one zero one eight.
scenarios.notes: Retain the quantity label; do not interpret this as an altitude or a clearance.

scenarios.title: Runway designator
scenarios.context: Fictional runway designator. No runway access is authorised.
scenarios.prompt: Read the designator Runway 27.
scenarios.model: Runway two seven.
scenarios.notes: A designator is not permission to enter, cross or take off.

scenarios.title: Heading digits
scenarios.context: A numeric pronunciation drill, not a control instruction.
scenarios.prompt: Read heading 080.
scenarios.model: Heading zero eight zero.
scenarios.notes: Preserve the leading zero in this drill and distinguish heading from track.

scenarios.title: Initial information request
scenarios.context: Your training token is ZS-ABC. You are in a fictional briefing position called North Point.
scenarios.prompt: Make a concise first contact to Dune Information, giving your identity and North Point, requesting information.
scenarios.model: Dune Information, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, North Point, request information.
scenarios.notes: This is a structural rehearsal, not universal phraseology for every local service.

scenarios.title: Report ready to a training operations desk
scenarios.context: You are rehearsing a crew briefing, not contacting ATC.
scenarios.prompt: Tell Training Operations that UAV Alpha One is ready for its briefing.
scenarios.model: Training Operations, UAV Alpha One, ready for briefing.
scenarios.notes: A briefing readiness report is not an operating clearance or a filed flight plan.

scenarios.title: Request missing information
scenarios.context: The fictional brief omits a required reporting point.
scenarios.prompt: Ask Dune Information to confirm the reporting point, using ZS-ABC.
scenarios.model: Dune Information, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, confirm reporting point.
scenarios.notes: Identify the missing item. Do not invent a reporting point from an earlier scenario.

scenarios.title: Preserve a runway restriction
scenarios.context: Fictional aircraft scenario; current local procedures need instructor review.
scenarios.prompt: Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, hold short of runway two seven.
scenarios.model: Holding short of runway two seven, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Acknowledge the actual restriction. The exercise never grants runway entry or take-off authority.

scenarios.title: Remain outside a training boundary
scenarios.context: The boundary and reporting point are fictional.
scenarios.prompt: Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, remain outside the training boundary, report North Point.
scenarios.model: Remaining outside the training boundary, report North Point, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Retain both the restriction and the reporting point. A token match does not validate every part of a response.

scenarios.title: Preserve the pressure setting
scenarios.context: Synthetic value for practice only.
scenarios.prompt: Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, QNH one zero one eight.
scenarios.model: QNH one zero one eight, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Compare every digit and the identity. Do not add an unrelated instruction.

scenarios.title: Read back a report requirement
scenarios.context: The point is fictional.
scenarios.prompt: Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, report South Gate.
scenarios.model: Report South Gate, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Keep the report requirement distinct from permission to proceed beyond a restriction.

scenarios.title: Receipt is not a full required readback
scenarios.context: A station has explicitly requested a readback of a runway restriction.
scenarios.prompt: Explain why responding only ROGER would not complete the requested readback.
scenarios.model: ROGER acknowledges receipt; I must still read back the required restriction and identity.
scenarios.notes: The checker checks selected concepts only; review your complete explanation with the lesson.

scenarios.title: Request a missed value
scenarios.context: You did not understand the pressure-setting value.
scenarios.prompt: Ask for repetition of the QNH, using ZS-ABC.
scenarios.model: Say again QNH, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Do not guess the value. The model is a concise fictional rehearsal.

scenarios.title: Correct your own report point
scenarios.context: You just said North Point but intended South Gate.
scenarios.prompt: Rehearse an explicit correction with your training identity.
scenarios.model: Correction, South Gate, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Make clear which version replaces the mistaken item. Do not leave two competing values.

scenarios.title: Clarify an omitted height reference
scenarios.context: A desk exercise states a height without its reference.
scenarios.prompt: State the clarification needed rather than guessing what the number means.
scenarios.model: Confirm height reference and units.
scenarios.notes: This is a briefing clarification exercise, not complete live radiotelephony phraseology for all contexts.

scenarios.title: Communicate inability honestly
scenarios.context: In a fictional rehearsal, you cannot comply with a requested report because the location is uncertain.
scenarios.prompt: Rehearse a clear statement of inability and request clarification, using ZS-ABC.
scenarios.model: Unable, position uncertain, request clarification, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Do not acknowledge compliance that you cannot provide. Actual operational response follows the approved procedure.

scenarios.title: Notice another addressee
scenarios.context: Your training identity ends Charlie. The received identity ends Delta.
scenarios.prompt: Dune Tower addresses Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Delta. What must you notice before responding?
scenarios.model: The message is not addressed to my callsign. I must not assume it is mine; clarify identity if needed.
scenarios.notes: This is a recognition question. Do not read the instruction back as if it was for ZS-ABC.

scenarios.title: Notice changed content
scenarios.context: An earlier rehearsal used North Point. The new instruction uses South Gate.
scenarios.prompt: Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, report South Gate.
scenarios.model: Report South Gate, Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie.
scenarios.notes: Read the received message, not the one you expected.

scenarios.title: Give a stated position
scenarios.context: Fictional observation point; no real navigation information.
scenarios.prompt: Report that ZS-ABC is at North Point.
scenarios.model: Zulu Sierra Alfa Bravo Charlie, North Point.
scenarios.notes: Use the stated information. Do not invent time, height or a clearance.

scenarios.title: Use an explicit crew stop message
scenarios.context: Crew coordination rehearsal, not ATC phraseology.
scenarios.prompt: Tell Training Operations that UAV Alpha One is stopping the exercise because its brief is incomplete.
scenarios.model: Training Operations, UAV Alpha One, stopping exercise, brief incomplete.
scenarios.notes: The exercise encourages speaking up. It does not prescribe an aircraft emergency control sequence.

scenarios.title: Close a fictional rehearsal
scenarios.context: The tabletop session is complete; no flight occurred.
scenarios.prompt: Report the end of the training exercise to Training Operations, using UAV Alpha One.
scenarios.model: Training Operations, UAV Alpha One, training exercise complete.
scenarios.notes: Do not turn this into an unsupported statement that a real aircraft has landed safely.

scenarios.title: Plan fictional distress information
scenarios.context: TABLETOP ONLY. An instructor must review category and actual phraseology. No live transmission.
scenarios.prompt: List the key information you would prepare for a distress communication rehearsal.
scenarios.model: Training only: identity, nature of distress, intentions, position and relevant additional information.
scenarios.notes: This is an information-planning card. It is not an executable emergency procedure or an assessment of correct event classification.

scenarios.title: Distinguish urgency from routine traffic
scenarios.context: TABLETOP ONLY. Use the current official manual and instructor review.
scenarios.prompt: Which standard signal identifies urgency, and can this browser exercise be used as a real transmission?
scenarios.model: PAN PAN identifies urgency. This is a training exercise, not a live transmission.
scenarios.notes: The lab does not assess whether a real event is correctly classified or managed.

scenarios.title: Detect a wrong runway readback
scenarios.context: The instruction refers to runway 27; the proposed reply says runway 09.
scenarios.prompt: What is wrong with the proposed readback, and what should happen to the discrepancy?
scenarios.model: The runway designator is wrong: two seven was changed to zero nine. The discrepancy needs correction.
scenarios.notes: A confident voice does not repair a changed restriction or value.

scenarios.title: Keep local procedure current
scenarios.context: You found an old internet script with a real frequency.
scenarios.prompt: Explain what must be checked before treating a procedure or frequency as current operational information.
scenarios.model: Check the current authoritative publication, applicability, validity and approved local procedure.
scenarios.notes: A practice script and a current operational information source have different purposes.
